planSteps.description: In a fresh session open https://loopledger-s4-git-feat-season4-b35ea5-jerrys-projects-82705168.vercel.app and stay on this exact hostname. Verify there is no selected PR. Focus Open recorded case and activate it with Enter.

Verify the Recorded case warning says Not the current PR head. Case findings must distinguish 7 passed / 1 blocked from the separate strict 8/8 replay. The comparison shows babd5af9be69 to 213172ab23e4 and exactly one changed outcome: Recovered, TestSprite S4 strict suite.

Inspect link destinations without navigating away: Before points to https://github.com/JerryNee/LoopLedger/actions/runs/40145334008/job/121025328126 and After to https://github.com/JerryNee/LoopLedger/actions/runs/40145526729/job/121025907592. These are links to historical results, not live-run claims.
Enable Include unchanged outcomes and new attempts. Verify five comparison rows, then disable it and verify one row again.
Open Report, retain its complete Markdown text, activate Download evidence report and wait for the actual browser download.

Read the actual downloaded PR-1-evidence.md file. Its complete content must equal the visible report and include Not the current PR head, Changes since baseline, Recovered, babd5af9be6984dc764b14323ff5fc14410a21ef, and 213172ab23e4ed85a3aeb4e1c2aa9829bc98dc59. An on-page preview or fetching a Blob URL is not proof of a downloaded file. If the file cannot be read, mark this assertion blocked, not passed.
Set the browser viewport to 390 by 844, return to Checks, and verify the Comparison baseline selector is usable and the document does not overflow horizontally.

Select Back to my workspace. Verify no selected PR and an empty Pull request URL. Reload and verify Open recorded case is visible with no selected PR; the historical example must not populate personal saved history.
